what_this_is: The Workshop rows for automatic replies by keyword rule (tools/reply-by-keyword-rule): decide which reply to send for any place a row names (read-data/reply-places.json), then send it once with that place's send row.

payload.label: Decide the replies
payload.job: Say which automatic reply to send now to each message or comment a person received on one of their connected places, by their keyword rules, and which to leave and why
payload.description: Says for each item of one place whether a rule's reply is to be sent now, from what the request holds: the person's reply rules (their reply-rule rows, in order), the place's row (read-data/reply-places.json: where its items come from, whose words are the person's own, how long a reply is allowed, who it goes to), the items of that place handed in as pulled.<channel id> (a channel with nothing handed in is named under not_pulled), the person's own id at the place (self_id) and the replies already kept (their reply-kept rows). The rule must match, the item must be someone else's, and the place's window, if it sets one, must still be open. A reply already kept is never chosen again. The person's AI reads those rows from their store and gives them; the tool reads nothing, sends nothing and keeps nothing: the place's send row (its send_tool) sends one chosen reply.

place.description: The place's row id in reply-places.json, for example reply-place:instagram or reply-place:youtube

pulled.description: The items of the place by channel id. A channel that answers pulled threads gets an array of threads { id, messages: [...] }; a channel that answers a pull tool's answers gets an array of those answers (one per page or video)

now.description: The time to judge the windows at, an ISO time; default the time now

rules.description: The person's reply-rule rows, each { id?, value: { id, enabled, words, mode, reply, order } }

self_id.description: The person's own id at the place (their pulled account id, or the field of their connection the place row names); their own words are never answered

kept.description: The person's reply-kept rows already held, each { id?, value: { key, place, state } }; a key in them is never chosen again

value.reply: Hi, the price list is here.

payload.label: Send a reply on Instagram
payload.job: Send one chosen automatic reply to one Instagram message or comment, once, while its place's window, if it sets one, is still open
payload.description: Give account_id and one decision from tool:decide-the-replies whose action is send. The place row's request for the decision's channel is sent (read-data/reply-places.json), the window is checked again at the moment of sending: a closed window sends nothing. The reply's reply-kept row is in the answer (`keep`: sent, failed or not-known) for the person's AI to keep, and the rows already held are given in `kept`: a key in them is never sent again; if no answer comes back the reply is not-known for a person to look at, and it is not retried. The account's held token is placed only on the request, only to the place's own hosts, never kept or answered. It posts publicly on the person's account: run it only for replies the person's rules chose.

account_id.description: One of the person's Instagram accounts, service_connection:instagram or service_connection:instagram:<account>

decision.description: One decision from tool:decide-the-replies whose action is send

kept.description: The person's reply-kept rows already held, each { id?, value: { key, place, state } }; a decision whose key is in them is never sent again

keep.description: The reply-kept row for this reply { id, type, value: { key, place, account_id, state } }, for the person's AI to keep; absent when nothing was sent or tried

decision.reply_text: Hi, the price list is here.
